description: App crashes on login page with 500 error when submitting the form.
Database connection timeout during car booking process.
User profile image fails to upload, showing 'File too large' error in console.
Payment gateway returns 401 Unauthorized during checkout.
Search function returns empty array even when cars are available.
Email verification link is broken and gives a 404 page.
Admin dashboard is very slow to load, taking over 10 seconds.
Car rental price calculation is incorrect when adding discount code.
Session expires randomly while the user is actively filling out the rental form.
The date picker allows users to select dates in the past for a rental.
